title: Trump announces White House ban on CNN, other media outlets
description: U.S. President Donald Trump announced an immediate White House ban on a number of news outlets, including CNN.
text:
U.S. President Donald Trump announced an immediate White House ban on a number of news outlets, including CNN. Trump bans CNN and other media outlets from White House U.S.

President Donald Trump announced an immediate White House ban on a number of news outlets on Friday, including CNN. Trump, in a social media post, said MS NOW and Politico are also barred, adding, "other fake news media outlets to follow." "Media Outlets shouldn’t be able to constantly write or report fiction. And lies when they’re covering the President of the United States, the Trump Administration, or the United States of America," he wrote.

In a statement, CNN said it stands behind its "fair and accurate" reporting, and said they have a constitutional right to work without government interference.
